testcase.name: Scenario: Expand and collapse nested entries in the solid-bodies folder: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:586:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand and collapse nested entries in the solid-bodies folder ✔ Given a part with one solid body made from an extrusion and sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Solid Bodies folder is collapsed in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks Solid Bodies ✔ Then its context menu offers Visibility, Expand All Children and Collapse All Children ✔ When the user chooses Expand All Children ✔ Then the folder displays the body row ✔ And the body displays its extrusion and underlying sketch as nested rows ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children ✔ Then the body row remains visible beneath the folder ✔ And the extrusion and sketch rows beneath that body are hidden ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
